candidates.title: StreamEval: Evaluating Interactive Streaming Video Generation Models
candidates.summary: Unified benchmark over five tasks (avatar dialogue, performance, world generation, instruction and reference editing) for real-time interactive video generation.

candidates.title: Matrix-Game 4.0: Real-Time Playable Game Worlds from Video Models
candidates.summary: Separates game execution (rules, persistent state) from visual generation via an executable game harness for low-latency playable worlds.

candidates.title: PAR: Progress-Aligned Recurrence for Length Generalization in State Tracking
candidates.summary: Trains looped language models so each iteration advances state a controlled amount, letting extra test-time iterations help on longer problems.

candidates.title: CoEvo-RSI: When Harnesses Evolve, Which Models Should Follow?
candidates.summary: Studies brain-body mismatch when an agent scaffold and its model co-evolve in recursive self-improving agents.

candidates.title: Right Screen, Wrong Transition: World Models as Verifiers for GUI Agents
candidates.summary: Argues GUI agent safety is a property of screen transitions, not screens, and uses world models to verify them.

candidates.title: Cache Engineering for Agents
candidates.summary: Treats KV cache I/O, storage and active growth as the dominant cost in long agent trajectories and proposes cache control.

candidates.title: Deep Search in Real-World Web Environments
candidates.summary: Benchmark of end-to-end deep search agents on the live open web across sources, modalities and formats.

candidates.title: SpatialScout: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore and Map 3D Scenes?
candidates.summary: Tests whether VLM agents can build accurate metric maps through autonomous exploration.

candidates.title: DecisionPivot: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Decision Models in LLM Systems
candidates.summary: 48 tasks, 40k+ items testing routers, guardrails and verifiers for consistency and calibration, beyond item accuracy.

candidates.title: Toward Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI
candidates.summary: Extends self-rewriting agent ideas to the physical world, learning from partial observations.

notes: Summaries are from HF abstract excerpts; arXiv URLs derived from HF paper IDs, not separately fetched.
